detail.decision: Units: mm. Template identity: unresolved between fsaverage (=MNI305 Talairach, coordsystem.json) and ICBM152 MNI (README); both are MNI-type template spaces whose axes agree and whose offsets are a few mm, which coordinate values alone cannot separate. Use as MNI-like template coordinates in mm; do not treat as verified ICBM152 nor as patient-native.

findings.detail: 500 Hz (lowpass 250 Hz) - lower than the 512/1024 Hz of other HUP cases; resampling needed for pooled analyses
9 soz contacts, 4 resect contacts; soz not in resect: RA2, RA3, RA4, RAT1, RAT2, RDNET1, RDNET2; resect not soz: RAT3, RAT4 (delivered-intervention linkage only, no outcome)

many good channels exceed 500 uV std over whole ictal runs; segment check (window_check.py): good-channel median std pre-onset 151-165 uV, seizure 779-885 uV, post-offset 212-390 uV, interictal 77-90 uV -> amplitude rise is confined to the annotated seizure (physiological), not a recording fault

both ictal runs contain one all-channel step (~3.2-3.4 mV median) 0.44-0.46 s before the end of the file (229.56 s, 253.54 s), outside the seizure; last 1 s median std 1.6-1.7 mV -> trim the final 1 s of ictal runs
good-channel median 60-Hz ratio 16-28 dB in all runs (higher than other cases); notch filtering required
absolute max ~15.7 mV (ictal) / ~11.3 mV (interictal) on at least one good channel; possible clipping not assessed per channel
61 ch, 500 Hz, uV, no EDF-embedded annotations; durations match ieeg.json RecordingDuration (+1 sample convention)

missingness.interictal_events: not applicable (no events.tsv for interictal runs, as expected)
